methodology.timer: DuckDB CLI .timer real wall seconds, 1 ms resolution
methodology.runs: One warmup then five measured runs; one process per query/thread count; t1 and t24
methodology.timed_scope: Complete authored SELECT in CLI .mode trash. No answer CSV formatting, serialization, download or comparison. Intrinsic engine result materialization/consumption remains part of query execution.
methodology.loading_excluded: Database creation/export, process startup/database opening and SET threads excluded. Query-required scanning, decompression and reads remain timed; same-query warmup precedes samples.
methodology.aggregation: Median of five measured samples, excluding warmup
